title: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
title_zh: 当更快的决策并未造就更优的智能体：智能体工作流程中 Jev 应用的实证研究

paragraphs.en: AI agents depend on repeated decisions to accomplish tasks, with large language models (LLMs) commonly serving as their core decision makers. The recent emergence of Jev offers an opportunity to make these decisions faster and at lower cost. However, it remains unclear whether such local savings can be translated into efficient and reliable task completion. In this paper, we investigate this efficiency transfer across five agents in two representative application settings, embodied tasks in ALFWorld and mobile app use in AndroidWorld. Across 4,500 task executions, we jointly evaluate task effectiveness, decision-level and task-level resource use, and execution behavior. Experimental results show that Jev integration substantially reduces decision cost and latency across all five agents, with task-level gains varying by workflow. Task success remains close to baseline levels on ALFWorld and declines more substantially in two mobile agents. Auxiliary reasoning and additional interactions absorb decision savings, while failed recovery and premature completion limit successful delivery. Mean cost per successful outcome increases in one agent even as spending per attempt falls. These findings highlight the importance of preserving progress, supporting recovery, and verifying completion when integrating efficient decision models into agent workflows. Their practical value should be assessed through successful task delivery, recovery behavior, and resources per delivered outcome.

paragraphs.en: AI agents pursue goals through interaction with their environments, with LLMs supporting this process in different scenarios ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Some decisions require open-ended code or text generation, while others involve selecting among available tools, interface elements, or admissible commands ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . These bounded choices are repeated throughout a task, and make both action-selection quality and resource efficiency important to overall agent performance ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Answering this question requires following decisions through complete agent workflows. Actions shape subsequent observations and choices, so each decision affects the conditions for the next ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . An executable action can move an agent away from its goal, requiring further reasoning or recovery whose cost may offset local savings. Reflection extends these dependencies across attempts ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , and candidate construction shapes the choices available to the decision model ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Task efficiency therefore depends on auxiliary reasoning, interaction overhead, and the sequence of actions performed. Failed attempts also consume resources without delivering the requested outcome. Evaluating agent performance requires connecting decision-level savings to task success, overall resource use, and resources per successful outcome, supported by repeated evaluation and execution analysis ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 回答这个问题需要通过对完整的智能体工作流程进行决策。 行动会影响后续的观察和选择，因此每个决策都会影响下一个决策的条件（Ross 等，2011）。 一个可执行的动作可能会使智能体偏离其目标，从而需要进一步的推理或恢复，而这些操作的成本可能抵消局部节省的资源。 反思将这些依赖关系扩展到多次尝试之中（Shinn 等，2023），而候选项的构建则决定了决策模型可用的选择（Yang 等，2024）。 因此，任务效率取决于辅助推理、交互开销以及所执行行动的顺序。 失败的尝试也会消耗资源，却无法带来预期的结果。 评估智能体的性能需要将决策层面的节省与任务成功、总体资源使用以及每次成功结果所消耗的资源联系起来，这需要通过反复的评估和执行分析来实现（Kapoor 等，2025；Yao 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: To provide this evidence, we conduct a comparative empirical study of AI agents with Jev-based action selection. The study covers five agent families in two representative application settings, embodied tasks in ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) and mobile app use in AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) . Within each family, we compare the original configuration with a Jev-integrated variant, using text-only observations to match Jev’s supported inputs ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ) . Each configuration runs three times on the same tasks, yielding 4,500 task executions. We jointly evaluate task effectiveness, decision-level and task-level resource use, and execution behavior. Paired task-level analyses estimate uncertainty in the observed differences, while systematic trace coding characterizes failure and recovery patterns. Comparisons with the original configurations assess integration effects.
paragraphs.zh: 为提供这一证据，我们对采用 Jev 基行动选择的 AI 智能体进行了比较性实证研究。 该研究涵盖了两个代表性应用设置中的五类智能体家族，包括 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2021）中的具身任务以及 AndroidWorld（Rawles 等人，2025）中的移动应用使用场景。 在每个家族内部，我们将原始配置与集成 Jev 的变体进行比较，并使用纯文本观察数据以匹配 Jev 所支持输入类型（TypeSafe AI，2026a）。 每种配置在相同任务上运行三次，共产生了 4,500 次任务执行。 我们共同评估了任务有效性、决策层和任务层的资源使用以及执行行为。 成对的任务层面分析估算了观察到的差异中的不确定性，而系统化的轨迹编码则描述了失败与恢复模式。 与原始配置的比较用于评估集成效果。

paragraphs.en: Jev. TypeSafe AI introduced Jev in September 2026 as a System One Model for fast, structured decisions in software automation ( Almeida, 2026 ) . Its API maps a shared state and instruction-defined questions to typed choices, scores, or binary probabilities. Questions are evaluated independently, and choice questions return probabilities over supplied candidates ( TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) . Entailment-based classifiers and GLiClass support labels supplied at inference time ( Yin et al., 2019 ; Stepanov et al., 2025 ) . Jev’s choice interface accepts candidate descriptions and instructions that define the decision to make. An agent can supply its goal, observations, and available actions as context for each selection. This connects the typed interface to repeated decisions within a workflow. Early Jev studies examine probabilistic coding of crash narratives ( Rafe and Das, 2026 ) and adoption across public software projects ( Ling et al., 2026 ) . We examine how its structured decisions interact with reasoning, environment feedback, and repeated action selection during task execution.
paragraphs.zh: Jev。 TypeSafe AI 于 2026 年 9 月推出了 Jev，将其作为 System One 模型，用于在软件自动化中实现快速、结构化的决策（Almeida, 2026）。 其 API 将共享状态和由指令定义的问题映射为带类型的选项、评分或二元概率。 问题会被独立评估，而选择性问题则会返回所提供候选项的概率分布（TypeSafe AI, 2026b）。 基于蕴含关系的分类器和 GLiClass 支持在推理时提供标签（Yin et al., 2019；Stepanov et al., 2025）。 Jev 的选择接口接受候选项描述和定义需执行决策的指令。 智能体可以为每次选择提供其目标、观察结果和可用操作作为上下文。 这将带类型的接口与工作流程中的重复决策连接起来。 早期的 Jev 研究探讨了故障叙述的概率编码（Rafe and Das, 2026）以及其在公共软件项目中的采用情况（Ling et al., 2026）。 我们研究了其结构化决策在执行任务期间如何与推理、环境反馈和重复动作选择相互作用。

paragraphs.en: Agent Action Selection. LLM agents repeatedly map goals, observations, and interaction history to actions through reasoning and environment interaction ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . Their interfaces expose commands, UI operations, and tools across embodied, mobile, and software tasks ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Tool use requires deciding which APIs to invoke, when to call them, and which arguments to supply ( Schick et al., 2023 ) . A finite set of action types can still require open-ended arguments, so bounded selection and generation coexist within one agent. The surrounding workflow determines which candidates are available and how the selected action is executed. Feedback, reflection, and memory condition later decisions on earlier outcomes ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . We focus on the bounded-selection component, examining how a specialized decision model interacts with the workflow’s reasoning, environment interaction, and recovery mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体动作选择。 LLM 智能体通过推理和环境交互，反复将目标、观察结果和交互历史映射为具体动作（Yao 等，2023）。 它们的接口支持命令、用户界面操作以及跨具身、移动和软件任务的工具（Wang 等，2024；Wen 等，2024；Yang 等，2024）。 工具使用需要决定调用哪些 API、何时调用以及提供哪些参数（Schick 等，2023）。 有限的动作类型集合仍可能需要开放式的参数，因此有界选择与生成能力可在同一智能体中共存。 周围的工作流决定了哪些候选选项可用，以及所选动作如何执行。 反馈、反思和记忆会影响后续决策对早期结果的判断（Shinn 等，2023；Wang 等，2024；Yang 等，2026）。 我们专注于有界选择部分，研究一个专门的决策模型如何与工作流的推理、环境交互及恢复机制相互作用。

paragraphs.en: Efficient Decision Models and Routing. Routing and cascades assign requests across models using difficulty, preferences, or confidence to balance cost and response quality ( Ding et al., 2024 ; Ong et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) . Agent systems extend model allocation to collaboration modes and roles through MasRouter ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . EvoRoute uses experience and environment feedback for step-level backbone selection, evaluating performance, cost, and latency ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . These methods optimize which model a system invokes. We study specialized bounded action selection across five agent families, characterizing when decision-level savings transfer to task-level efficiency considering auxiliary reasoning, interaction length, recovery, and completion.
paragraphs.zh: 高效决策模型与路由。 路由与级联机制根据难度、偏好或置信度将请求分配至不同模型，以平衡成本与响应质量（Ding 等，2024；Ong 等，2025；Shen 等，2025）。 Agent 系统通过 MasRouter（Yue 等，2025）将模型分配扩展至协作模式与角色。 EvoRoute 利用经验与环境反馈进行逐步骨干选择，评估性能、成本与延迟（Zhang 等，2026a）。 这些方法优化了系统调用哪个模型。 我们研究了五个 Agent 家族中的专用有界动作选择，并描述了在考虑辅助推理、交互时长、恢复与完成度的情况下，决策层面的节省何时能转化为任务层面的效率提升。

paragraphs.en: Agent Evaluation and Sequential Reliability. Benchmarks assess task outcomes across embodied, web, mobile, desktop, and software-engineering environments ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2024b ; Rawles et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . ALFWorld and AndroidWorld provide the outcomes for our household and mobile evaluations. Resource-aware evaluation considers accuracy and expenditure, while repeated trials assess consistency ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . Sequential errors can compound as earlier decisions alter the states encountered later ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . Feedback, reflection, and tree search support correction across attempts or alternative action paths ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024a ) . Failure analysis identifies difficulties in long-term reasoning, decision-making, and instruction following ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Trajectory diagnosis evaluates backtracking, observation reading, and self-verification in web agents ( Ou et al., 2025 ) . We connect decision-level resources to total expenditure and resources per delivered success, including failed attempts, and characterize recovery and completion errors through trace coding.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体评估与序列可靠性。 基准测试用于评估智能体在具身、网络、移动、桌面和软件工程环境中的任务结果（Shridhar 等，2021；Zhou 等，2024b；Rawles 等，2025；Xie 等，2024；Jimenez 等，2024）。 ALFWorld 和 AndroidWorld 为我们提供了家庭场景和移动场景评估的结果。 资源感知评估会同时考虑准确性与资源消耗，而重复试验则用于评估一致性（Kapoor 等，2025；Yao 等，2025）。 序列中的错误可能会累积，因为早期的决策会改变后续所遇到的状态（Ross 等，2011）。 反馈、反思和树搜索有助于在多次尝试或不同行动路径中实现纠错（Shinn 等，2023；Zhou 等，2024a）。 失败分析能够识别长期推理、决策和指令执行中的困难（Liu 等，2024）。 轨迹诊断用于评估网络智能体在回溯、观察解读和自我验证方面的表现（Ou 等，2025）。 我们将决策层面的资源消耗与总资源消耗以及每次成功交付所需的资源联系起来，其中也包括失败尝试的成本，并通过轨迹编码来描述恢复错误和完成错误。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We study action selection in two complementary interaction environments. AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) covers mobile application tasks, where agents act on changing UI elements and application states. We use text-based UI observations and one fixed parameter instance for each of its 116 task types. ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) covers household tasks through textual observations and admissible commands. We use its text environment and all 134 tasks in the valid_unseen split. Together, these settings cover UI interaction and command-based control with language-based observations.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 我们在两个互补的交互环境中研究动作选择问题。 AndroidWorld（Rawles 等人，2025）涵盖移动应用任务，其中智能体会对不断变化的用户界面元素和应用状态进行操作。 对于其 116 种任务类型中的每一种，我们都使用基于文本的用户界面观察结果和一个固定的参数实例。 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2021）通过文本观察和允许使用的命令来涵盖家庭事务任务。 我们使用其文本环境以及有效未见数据集中全部 134 个任务。 综合来看，这些设置涵盖了基于用户界面的交互和基于命令的控制，并辅以语言相关的观察信息。

paragraphs.en: Agent Configurations. Since Jev accepts only text input currently, we select text-only agent configurations to match input modalities across variants. Table 1 lists six configurations per benchmark, named Agent-B , Agent-J , and Agent-C for Baseline, Jev, and LLM-Choice. AndroidWorld includes T3A ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) , AutoDroid ( Wen et al., 2024 ) , and Droidrun’s FastAgent ( Droidrun, 2026 ) , covering UI action generation, candidate-event selection, and tool invocation. Each has B and J variants, with FastAgent in text-only Direct mode and AutoDroid’s app-specific memory disabled in both. ALFWorld includes ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) and Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , which support within-trial reasoning and cross-trial reflection, respectively. Each has B , J , and C variants. The C control is needed because Jev integration adds admissible-command access as well as changing the decision model. It uses an LLM with Jev’s candidate list and selection instructions. B – C comparisons therefore assess the candidate-selection interface, while C – J comparisons assess the decision model under that interface.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体配置。 由于 Jev 目前仅接受文本输入，因此我们选择仅使用文本的智能体配置，以确保不同变体之间输入模态的一致性。 表 1 列出了每个基准测试的六种配置，分别命名为 Agent-B、Agent-J 和 Agent-C，对应 Baseline、Jev 和 LLM-Choice。 AndroidWorld 包括 T3A（Rawles 等，2025）、AutoDroid（Wen 等，2024）以及 Droidrun 的 FastAgent（Droidrun，2026），涵盖 UI 动作生成、候选事件选择和工具调用。 每个系统都有 B 和 J 变体，其中 FastAgent 采用仅文本的 Direct 模式，而 AutoDroid 在两种模式中都禁用了应用特定的内存功能。 ALFWorld 包括 ReAct（Yao 等，2023）和 Reflexion（Shinn 等，2023），分别支持试验内的推理和跨试验的反思。 每个系统都有 B、J 和 C 变体。 需要设置 C 控制组，因为 Jev 的集成不仅增加了可用命令的访问权限，还改变了决策模型。 它使用一个 LLM，并配合 Jev 的候选列表和选择指令。 因此，B–C 的比较评估的是候选选择界面，而 C–J 的比较则评估在该界面下的决策模型。

sents.en: Table 1 lists six configurations per benchmark, named Agent-B , Agent-J , and Agent-C for Baseline, Jev, and LLM-Choice.
sents.zh: 表 1 列出了每个基准测试的六种配置，分别命名为 Agent-B、Agent-J 和 Agent-C，对应 Baseline、Jev 和 LLM-Choice。

sents.en: AndroidWorld includes T3A ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) , AutoDroid ( Wen et al., 2024 ) , and Droidrun’s FastAgent ( Droidrun, 2026 ) , covering UI action generation, candidate-event selection, and tool invocation.
sents.zh: AndroidWorld 包括 T3A（Rawles 等，2025）、AutoDroid（Wen 等，2024）以及 Droidrun 的 FastAgent（Droidrun，2026），涵盖 UI 动作生成、候选事件选择和工具调用。

sents.en: Each has B and J variants, with FastAgent in text-only Direct mode and AutoDroid’s app-specific memory disabled in both.
sents.zh: 每个系统都有 B 和 J 变体，其中 FastAgent 采用仅文本的 Direct 模式，而 AutoDroid 在两种模式中都禁用了应用特定的内存功能。

sents.en: ALFWorld includes ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) and Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , which support within-trial reasoning and cross-trial reflection, respectively.
sents.zh: ALFWorld 包括 ReAct（Yao 等，2023）和 Reflexion（Shinn 等，2023），分别支持试验内的推理和跨试验的反思。

sents.en: Each has B , J , and C variants.
sents.zh: 每个系统都有 B、J 和 C 变体。

sents.en: The C control is needed because Jev integration adds admissible-command access as well as changing the decision model.
sents.zh: 需要设置 C 控制组，因为 Jev 的集成不仅增加了可用命令的访问权限，还改变了决策模型。

sents.en: It uses an LLM with Jev’s candidate list and selection instructions.
sents.zh: 它使用一个 LLM，并配合 Jev 的候选列表和选择指令。

sents.en: B – C comparisons therefore assess the candidate-selection interface, while C – J comparisons assess the decision model under that interface.
sents.zh: 因此，B–C 的比较评估的是候选选择界面，而 C–J 的比较则评估在该界面下的决策模型。

paragraphs.en: Jev Integration. We replace action selection with one logical Jev request per decision step, retaining the surrounding observation, history, and execution mechanisms. In AndroidWorld, Jev selects UI actions and targets for T3A, candidate events for AutoDroid, and tools with associated arguments for FastAgent. In ALFWorld, it selects an admissible command or THINK, which invokes LLM reasoning. Auxiliary LLMs supply open-ended text and summaries, including Reflexion’s reflections. The comparisons include two interface differences: ALFWorld baselines generate commands without candidate lists, and FastAgent-J executes one tool per step while FastAgent-B can emit multiple calls.
paragraphs.zh: Jev 集成。 我们将动作选择替换为每个决策步骤中一次逻辑性的 Jev 请求，同时保留周围的观察、历史和执行机制。 在 AndroidWorld 中，Jev 为 T3A 选择 UI 动作和目标，为 AutoDroid 选择候选事件，并为 FastAgent 选择带有相关参数的工具。 在 ALFWorld 中，它选择一个可执行的命令或 THINK，从而触发 LLM 推理。 辅助 LLM 提供开放式的文本和摘要，包括 Reflexion 的反思内容。 比较涉及两个接口差异：ALFWorld 基线模型生成命令时没有候选列表，而 FastAgent-J 每个步骤仅执行一个工具，FastAgent-B 则可以发出多个调用。

paragraphs.en: Execution Protocol. We run each configuration three times on the same task suite with seed 0 to measure variability on fixed instances. All LLM decisions and auxiliary generation use gpt-5.6-luna , and Jev decisions use jev-1.13.0 . Environment state and memory are reset between tasks and repetitions, with Reflexion memory retained only across trials of the same task. Budgets are matched within each agent family. AndroidWorld allows 600 seconds of agent execution and ⌈ 10 ​ c ⌉ \lceil 10c\rceil steps per task, where c c is task complexity. ALFWorld allows ReAct 49 steps and 600 seconds per task. Reflexion allows up to ten trials of 49 steps within 6,000 seconds, stopping upon success. Cross-family comparisons thus reflect different budgets as well as agent designs.
paragraphs.zh: 执行协议。 我们对每个配置在相同任务套件上运行三次，并使用种子值 0，以衡量其在固定实例上的变异性。 所有 LLM 决策和辅助生成均使用 gpt-5.6-luna，而 Jev 决策则使用 jev-1.13.0。 环境状态和记忆在任务与重复执行之间会被重置，但 Reflexion 记忆仅在同一任务的多次尝试中保留。 每个智能体家族内的预算是匹配的。 AndroidWorld 允许智能体在每个任务中执行 600 秒，并执行 ⌈ 10 ​ c ⌉ \lceil 10c\rceil 步，其中 c 表示任务复杂度。 ALFWorld 允许每个任务执行 ReAct 49 步，并持续 600 秒。 Reflexion 允许在 6,000 秒内最多进行十次每次 49 步的尝试，并在成功时停止。 因此，跨家族的比较不仅反映了不同的预算，也体现了不同的智能体设计。

paragraphs.en: Repeated Runs and Aggregation. To capture consistency and variability in agent execution, we evaluate each agent configuration three times on the same tasks, resetting environment state and agent memory between runs. We retain all task–run records and report the mean and sample standard deviation of each metric across runs. Paired analyses preserve task correspondence. We report J minus control differences with 95% task-cluster bootstrap intervals, resampling tasks and retaining their three runs together in 20,000 replicates. See Appendix A.2 for details.
paragraphs.zh: 重复运行与汇总。 为了捕捉智能体执行过程中的一致性与变异性，我们对每种智能体配置在相同任务上运行三次，并在每次运行之间重置环境状态和智能体记忆。 我们保留所有任务–运行记录，并报告各项指标在所有运行中的均值和样本标准差。 配对分析保留了任务对应关系。 我们报告 J 减去控制值的差异，并给出 95% 的任务簇自助置信区间；该区间通过 20,000 次重复抽样获得，每次均对任务进行重采样并保留其三次运行结果。 详见附录 A.2。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency and Cost. We measure token usage, inference cost, and elapsed time at both task and decision levels. Task-level token usage and cost include all model calls, including auxiliary generation and reflection, while decision-level metrics cover only action-selection calls. Inference costs are calculated using fixed model-specific input and output token prices. We report each metric over all tasks and over successful tasks only, with the latter including only decisions from successful executions. Task-level means divide the corresponding totals by the number of tasks, and decision-level means divide them by the number of action-selection calls within each scope. We also report cost and time per delivered success by dividing the corresponding totals across all attempts, including failures, by the number of successful executions.
paragraphs.zh: 效率与成本。 我们在任务层和决策层分别测量令牌使用量、推理成本和耗时。 任务层的令牌使用量和成本包含所有模型调用，包括辅助生成和反思；而决策层指标仅涵盖动作选择相关的调用。 推理成本基于固定的模型专用输入和输出令牌价格计算得出。 我们对所有任务以及仅对成功任务报告各项指标，其中后者仅包含成功执行中的决策。 任务层的平均值将对应总和除以任务数量，而决策层的平均值则将总和除以每个作用域内的动作选择调用次数。 我们还通过将所有尝试（包括失败）的对应总和除以成功执行次数，来报告每次成功交付所对应的成本和时间。

paragraphs.en: An uneven effectiveness gap. On ALFWorld, ReAct-J and Reflexion-J achieve 96.02% and 98.01% success, trailing their original configurations by 1.49 and 1.74 percentage points (pp), respectively (Figure 1 ). With the shared candidate interface in C, these gaps narrow to 1.00 and 0.00 pp. On AndroidWorld, Jev trails T3A, AutoDroid, and FastAgent by 13.22, 2.30, and 18.10 pp, respectively, with both AutoDroid variants below 20% success. Comparisons with original configurations capture system-level integration effects, including an interface change on ALFWorld. AndroidWorld agents already use predefined action lists. Jev thus retains nearly all success under ALFWorld’s shared interface but incurs larger losses in T3A and FastAgent. The 95% task-cluster bootstrap intervals for J–B success differences are entirely negative for T3A and FastAgent and include zero for the other agents and both ALFWorld J–C comparisons (Table 10 ). Appendix B reports supplementary results.
paragraphs.zh: 效果存在不均衡的差距。 在 ALFWorld 中，ReAct-J 和 Reflexion-J 的成功率分别为 96.02% 和 98.01%，分别比其原始配置低 1.49 和 1.74 个百分点（pp）（图 1）。 在 C 中共享候选接口后，这些差距缩小至 1.00 和 0.00 个百分点。 在 AndroidWorld 中，Jev 的成功率分别比 T3A、AutoDroid 和 FastAgent 低 13.22、2.30 和 18.10 个百分点，且两种 AutoDroid 变体的成功率均低于 20%。 与原始配置的对比能够反映系统层面的集成效应，包括 ALFWorld 中的接口变更。 AndroidWorld 的智能体已经使用预定义的动作列表。 因此，Jev 在 ALFWorld 的共享接口下几乎保持全部成功率，但在 T3A 和 FastAgent 中出现了更大的损失。 J–B 成功率差异的 95% 任务簇自助置信区间在 T3A 和 FastAgent 中完全为负值，在其他智能体以及 ALFWorld 的两种 J–C 比较中均包含零（表 10）。 附录 B 报告了补充结果。

paragraphs.en: Task difficulty extends beyond sequence length. Within these workflows, success varies with task demands (Figure 2 ). Both Jev families reach 100% success on ALFWorld’s examine, place, and cool tasks, and Jev improves ReAct’s success on two-object tasks. Cleaning produces deficits of about 8.6 pp and 7.5 pp, with a similar weakness in LLM-Choice. On AndroidWorld, T3A and FastAgent lose 12.5 and 15.3 pp even in the shortest-budget stratum, with larger deficits in the longest-budget stratum. Jev can sustain successful sequences with multiple subgoals, yet also lose effectiveness on short tasks. The longer-task deficits indicate an additional challenge, while the short-task failures direct attention to the judgments required within individual states. This pattern makes the content of a decision, including its target, prerequisites, and completion conditions, central to explaining the observed differences.
paragraphs.zh: 任务难度超出了序列长度的限制。 在这些工作流程中，成功与否因任务需求而异（图 2）。 Jev 的两个版本在 ALFWorld 的“检查”“放置”和“冷却”任务中均实现了 100% 的成功率，并且 Jev 提升了 ReAct 在处理双物体任务时的成功率。 “清洁”任务导致成功率分别下降了约 8.6 pp 和 7.5 pp，LLM-Choice 也存在类似的性能下降。 在 AndroidWorld 中，T3A 和 FastAgent 即使在预算最短的层级中也分别损失了 12.5 pp 和 15.3 pp，而在预算最长的层级中损失更为显著。 Jev 能够维持包含多个子目标的连续成功操作，但在短任务中也会失去有效性。 长任务中的性能下降表明存在额外挑战，而短任务中的失败则凸显了单个状态内所需判断的重要性。 这种模式表明，决策的具体内容——包括其目标、前提条件和完成条件——是解释所观察到的差异的关键因素。

sents.zh: 这种模式表明，决策的具体内容——包括其目标、前提条件和完成条件——是解释所观察到的差异的关键因素。

paragraphs.en: Errors become failures through termination or failed recovery. Trajectories connect these task differences to goal interpretation and correction. In the Wi-Fi task, Jev selects an ambiguously labeled switch and declares completion with the goal unmet. This terminal judgment ends the opportunity for correction. In ALFWorld, selecting a handtowel for a cloth leads the workflow to continue reasoning on the wrong object. The initial error is amplified as the agent repeatedly preserves the mistaken premise. These cases show how a decisive stopping error can end a short task, while an earlier selection error can develop into sustained failure through unsuccessful correction. Reflexion demonstrates recovery’s contribution at the task level, as Jev’s first-trial success advantage becomes a final deficit after further trials (Table 4 ). Its selection and auxiliary LLM reflection jointly determine this outcome. Effective decision making consequently requires both selecting a goal-appropriate action and revising previous choices when feedback reveals a mismatch.
paragraphs.zh: 错误通过终止或恢复失败而演变为失败。 轨迹将这些任务差异与目标解释和修正联系起来。 在 Wi-Fi 任务中，Jev 选错了一个标签模糊的开关，并宣布任务完成，但目标并未达成。 这种最终判断终结了进行修正的机会。 在 ALFWorld 中，为“布”选择擦手巾会导致工作流程继续对错误的对象进行推理。 初始错误被放大，因为智能体反复保留了错误的假设。 这些案例表明，一个决定性的停止错误可能结束一项简短的任务，而早期的选择错误则可能因未能成功修正而演变为持续失败。 Reflexion 展示了恢复在任务层面的贡献：Jev 首次尝试的成功优势在后续尝试后反而变成了最终劣势（表 4）。 其选择与辅助 LLM 的反思共同决定了这一结果。 因此，有效的决策既需要选择符合目标的动作，也需要在反馈显示不匹配时修正先前的选择。

paragraphs.en: Jev suits clearly specified decision roles. Jev is most promising when the decision input makes the goal, current state, and action prerequisites explicit, so selecting an action maps an understood state to a suitable next operation. Promising applications include workflow routing, API or tool selection, and routine software operations with identifiable targets and observable completion conditions. Workflows involving ambiguous goals, incomplete observations, or repeated sub-goal revision place greater demands on interpretation and recovery, the capabilities implicated in the observed mobile deficits. The effectiveness trade-off is strong execution within well-specified states versus adaptability when the agent must revise its understanding of the task. The strongest candidates for Jev have explicit conditions for choosing, checking, and completing an action.
paragraphs.zh: Jev 明确适用于特定的决策角色。 当决策输入明确说明目标、当前状态和行动前提时，Jev 的表现最为出色，此时选择行动即可将已理解的状态映射到合适的后续操作。 潜在的应用场景包括工作流路由、API 或工具的选择，以及具有明确目标和可观测完成条件的常规软件操作。 涉及模糊目标、不完整观察结果或重复修订子目标的工作流，对解释和恢复能力提出了更高要求，而这些能力正是已观察到的移动缺陷所涉及的。 其有效性权衡在于：在状态定义清晰时具备强大的执行能力，而在智能体必须重新理解任务时则需具备适应性。 Jev 最理想的适用场景是那些具有明确选择、验证和完成行动条件的情况。

paragraphs.en: Faster and cheaper action selection. Across all five families, Jev reduces mean decision cost by 66.1% – 78.4% and time by 73.9% – 81.5% (Figure 3 a). Decision times fall from 4.13 – 8.13 to 1.04 – 1.75 seconds (Appendix B.2 ), with both advantages persisting among successful tasks (Figure 3 b). Tokens per decision increase by 53.5% –134.9%, as selection consumes observations, choices, and history. Jev’s lower input price and zero output charge offset this increase.

paragraphs.en: Cost savings transfer more consistently than speed. Task-level gains are smaller and vary across workflows (Figure 3 a). On ALFWorld, ReAct and Reflexion reduce cost by 50.9% and 32.6%, and time by 47.6% and 37.8%, respectively. Against C, cost falls by 56.6% and 63.9%, with approximately 56.6% shorter task times (Appendix B.2 ). On AndroidWorld, T3A, AutoDroid, and FastAgent reduce cost by 17.1%, 68.8%, and 43.0%. Time falls by 10.6% and 5.7% for T3A and AutoDroid and rises by 0.7% for FastAgent. All families use more tokens per task. Paired 95% task-cluster bootstrap intervals support lower costs in all J–B comparisons except Reflexion, whose interval includes zero. Time intervals include zero for AutoDroid and FastAgent (Table 10 ). Cost savings thus transfer more consistently across workflows. These task-level comparisons capture the combined effects of action selection, auxiliary calls, and environment interaction under each integration.

paragraphs.en: Completion determines the value of savings. Every family is faster and cheaper on its own successful-task subset, which differs between configurations. On matched task–run pairs completed by both, ALFWorld retains 64.8–66.2% lower cost and 59.2–60.8% shorter execution (Table 2 a). AndroidWorld retains cost savings, while FastAgent’s time saving narrows to 5.5% and T3A becomes 1.1% slower. Paired cost intervals are below zero for all families, while time intervals include zero for T3A and FastAgent (Table 10 ). Failures add to delivery costs. In Reflexion-J , 2.0% of executions consume 53.3% of inference expenditure through unsuccessful recovery (Table 2 b). Across all attempts, cost per delivered success falls in four families and rises by 7.7% for T3A, from 68.70 to 73.97 mUSD (Table 2 c). This increase has a 95% interval spanning zero. At the observed means, lower completion offsets T3A’s 17.1% cost saving per attempt. FastAgent’s nearly unchanged task time and lower completion raise time per delivered success from 239.4 to 377.8 seconds. T3A also takes longer per success, with positive difference intervals for both agents. Completion and failed execution therefore shape the final resource benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 任务完成度决定了成本节省的幅度。 每个家庭在其自身成功完成任务的子集上都能实现更快、更低的成本，但这一子集在不同配置中有所不同。 在双方均完成的任务–运行匹配对中，ALFWorld 的成本仍低 64.8%–66.2%，执行时间仍短 59.2%–60.8%（表 2a）。 AndroidWorld 仍然实现了成本节省，而 FastAgent 的时间节省幅度缩小至 5.5%，T3A 则慢了 1.1%。 所有家庭的配对成本区间均低于零，而 T3A 和 FastAgent 的时间区间则包含零（表 10）。 失败会增加交付成本。 在 Reflexion-J 中，2.0% 的运行因恢复失败消耗了 53.3% 的推理支出（表 2b）。 在所有尝试中，每成功交付一次任务的成本在四个家庭中下降，而 T3A 则上升了 7.7%，从 68.70 增至 73.97 mUSD（表 2c）。 这一增长值的 95% 置信区间跨越了零。 在观测到的均值水平下，较低的完成度抵消了 T3A 每次尝试 17.1% 的成本节省。 FastAgent 的任务时间几乎未变，但较低的完成度使每成功交付一次任务的时间从 239.4 秒增至 377.8 秒。 T3A 每次成功所需的时间也更长，两个智能体的时间差异区间均为正值。 因此，任务完成度和执行失败共同决定了最终的资源效益。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency transfer depends on workflow overhead and completion. Decision savings transfer most directly when selection dominates resource use, auxiliary reasoning and additional interactions remain limited, and task success is preserved. ReAct meets these conditions and lowers both cost and time per delivered success. Auxiliary work, extra interactions, and lower completion weaken gains in T3A and FastAgent (Figure 4 , Table 2 ). Tool routing and software-service orchestration with lightweight operations and little auxiliary generation are promising settings. Slow external operations limit time savings. Practical value depends on workflow resource use, task completion, and the cost of unsuccessful execution.

paragraphs.en: Model development. Our findings point toward decision models trained for the consequences of sequential choices. Jev’s fast selection coexists with errors in target interpretation, correction, and termination, and these errors can consume its resource savings through prolonged execution. For Jev and Jev-like models, a promising direction is to retain concise numerical outputs while strengthening sensitivity to goals, action prerequisites, and contradictory feedback. Training on contrasting successful and failed trajectories could target decisions that restore progress or correctly end a task. Another useful objective is calibrated confidence in whether any available action advances the goal, giving the model a basis for requesting more information or reconsidering its choices. Progress should be assessed through successful task delivery and the resources it requires, alongside decision accuracy and response time.
paragraphs.zh: 模型开发。 我们的研究结果表明，决策模型应针对序列选择的后果进行训练。 Jev 的快速选择与目标解释、修正和终止方面的错误共存，而这些错误可能因执行时间过长而消耗其节省的资源。 对于 Jev 及类似模型，一个有前景的方向是保留简洁的数值输出，同时增强对目标、行动前提条件和矛盾反馈的敏感性。 在成功与失败的对比轨迹上进行训练，可以针对能够恢复进展或正确结束任务的决策进行优化。 另一个有用的目标是校准模型对“任何可用行动是否有助于推进目标”的信心程度，从而为模型请求更多信息或重新考虑其选择提供依据。 进展应通过任务的成功完成及其所需资源进行评估，同时还需考虑决策的准确率和响应时间。

paragraphs.en: Agentic system design. The engineering implication is to treat decision making as an explicit system component with observable inputs, outcomes, and costs. Candidate interfaces should expose target identity, prerequisites, and expected state changes, with feedback indicating whether the last action advanced the goal. Checks should focus on completion judgments and repeated lack of progress, the points where our traces show failures becoming terminal or persistent. Additional observation or reasoning can then be directed to unresolved decisions. This allocation matters because auxiliary calls and interaction overhead can absorb the savings from faster selection. Deployment decisions should jointly consider the original runtime bottleneck, changes in interaction length, and expenditure per successful outcome. Jev and Jev-like models are consequently most promising in systems that make routine choices inexpensive while concentrating verification and recovery on decisions that threaten completion.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统的设计。 其工程意义在于将决策视为一个显式的系统组件，具有可观测的输入、结果和成本。 候选接口应暴露目标身份、前提条件和预期的状态变化，并通过反馈表明上一次操作是否推动了目标实现。 检查应聚焦于完成判断以及持续缺乏进展的情况，这些正是我们的追踪记录显示失败变为终结性或持久性的节点。 随后可将额外的观察或推理资源集中用于尚未解决的决策。 这种分配之所以重要，是因为辅助调用和交互开销可能会抵消快速选择所带来的节省。 部署决策应综合考虑原始的运行时瓶颈、交互长度的变化以及每次成功结果所消耗的成本。 因此，Jev 及类似模型在那些使常规选择成本较低，同时将验证与恢复集中在可能威胁任务完成的决策上的系统中最具前景。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate AI agents with Jev-based action selection to examine whether faster, cheaper decisions translate into efficient and reliable task completion. Across five agents over two scenarios, decision savings yield workflow-dependent task gains. Success remains close to baseline on ALFWorld and falls more substantially in two mobile agents. Auxiliary reasoning and additional interactions absorb savings, while failed recovery and premature completion limit delivery. Mean cost per successful outcome rises in one agent despite lower spending per attempt. Agent workflows should preserve progress, support recovery, and verify completion. Efficient decision models should be assessed through successful delivery, recovery behavior, and resources per delivered outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用基于 Jev 的行动选择方法来评估 AI 智能体，以检验更快速、更便宜的决策是否能够实现高效且可靠的任务完成。 在两个场景下对五个智能体进行评估后发现，决策成本的节省带来了因工作流程而异的任务效率提升。 在 ALFWorld 中，成功表现仍接近基准水平，但在两个移动智能体中的下降则更为显著。 辅助推理和额外交互会消耗所节省的成本，而恢复失败和过早完成则会限制最终结果的交付。 尽管每次尝试的成本更低，但其中一个智能体的每次成功结果的平均成本却有所上升。 智能体的工作流程应能保留进度、支持恢复并验证任务是否完成。 高效的决策模型应通过成功交付、恢复行为以及每个交付结果所消耗的资源进行评估。

sents.en: Success remains close to baseline on ALFWorld and falls more substantially in two mobile agents.
sents.zh: 在 ALFWorld 中，成功表现仍接近基准水平，但在两个移动智能体中的下降则更为显著。

sents.en: Auxiliary reasoning and additional interactions absorb savings, while failed recovery and premature completion limit delivery.
sents.zh: 辅助推理和额外交互会消耗所节省的成本，而恢复失败和过早完成则会限制最终结果的交付。

sents.en: Mean cost per successful outcome rises in one agent despite lower spending per attempt.
sents.zh: 尽管每次尝试的成本更低，但其中一个智能体的每次成功结果的平均成本却有所上升。

sents.en: Agent workflows should preserve progress, support recovery, and verify completion.
sents.zh: 智能体的工作流程应能保留进度、支持恢复并验证任务是否完成。

sents.en: Efficient decision models should be assessed through successful delivery, recovery behavior, and resources per delivered outcome.
sents.zh: 高效的决策模型应通过成功交付、恢复行为以及每个交付结果所消耗的资源进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation scope. This study examines Jev integration in selected agent families across mobile application and household-task environments. Both settings use language-based observations and bounded action interfaces. Transfer to visually grounded agents, open-ended tool creation, and longer workflows requires further evaluation. The three repetitions characterize execution variability on fixed task instances with a shared seed. They do not measure variation across newly sampled environments or task distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 评估范围。 本研究在移动应用和家庭任务环境中，对选定的智能体家族中的 Jev 集成进行了考察。 两种环境均使用基于语言的观察和有限动作接口。 向以视觉为基础的智能体、开放式工具创建以及更长的工作流程进行迁移，还需要进一步评估。 三次重复实验刻画了在固定任务实例和共享种子条件下执行过程的变异性。 它们并未衡量在新采样环境或任务分布中的差异。

paragraphs.en: System-level comparisons. Jev operates within an agent workflow whose candidate construction, auxiliary generation, and feedback mechanisms jointly influence performance. Our comparisons therefore concern the evaluated integrations. The ALFWorld LLM-Choice control helps distinguish decision-model effects under a shared candidate interface, but this control does not cover every integration. Within-family budget matching supports comparisons between variants. Comparisons across families also reflect differences in interaction budgets and workflow design. The findings should consequently be interpreted in the context of these configurations, without attributing every observed difference to Jev alone.
paragraphs.zh: 系统级比较。 Jev 在一个智能体工作流中运行，其候选构建、辅助生成和反馈机制共同影响性能。 因此，我们的比较涉及所评估的集成方案。 ALFWorld LLM-Choice 对照有助于在共享候选接口下区分决策模型的影响，但该对照并未涵盖所有集成方案。 同类预算匹配支持不同变体之间的比较。 跨类比较也反映了交互预算和工作流设计的差异。 因此，在解释研究结果时，应结合这些配置背景进行，而不应将观察到的所有差异都归因于 Jev 本身。

paragraphs.en: Paired outcomes. Table 6 retains task–run correspondence. A gain is an execution completed by J but not by the specified control, and a loss is the reverse. Both-success counts determine the sample sizes used for matched resource comparisons. Adding gains to both-success counts gives the number of Jev successes, while adding losses gives the control successes. Their difference is the net change in successful executions. For a given benchmark, dividing this difference by the total executions converts it to the success-rate difference. These counts retain each run separately, so a task can contribute to different outcome categories across repetitions.
paragraphs.zh: 成对结果。 表 6 保留了任务与运行之间的对应关系。 收益是指由 J 完成但指定控制方未完成的一次执行，而损失则相反。 双方成功次数决定了用于匹配资源比较的样本大小。 将收益加到双方成功次数中，即可得到 Jev 成功的次数；而将损失相加，则得到控制方的成功次数。 两者的差值即为成功执行次数的净变化量。 对于给定的基准测试，将该差值除以总执行次数，即可将其转换为成功率差异。 这些计数分别保留每次运行的结果，因此同一任务在不同重复实验中可能贡献于不同的结果类别。

paragraphs.en: Behavior definitions. Target identification marks a wrong object, entity, or UI target. Prerequisite violation marks an attempted action or search with an unmet state or inventory condition. Failed recovery marks repeated unsuccessful operations or persistence in a contradicted premise after feedback. Premature completion marks an explicit completion claim while a goal condition remains unmet. Ineffective search marks repeated unproductive search, navigation, or strategy changes. Execution granularity marks an observed error from batched operations or stale action references. Output or state mismatch marks an explicit discrepancy between the delivered answer or state and the requested result or evaluator criterion. A failed outcome alone provides no behavior label. An execution can receive several labels, and successful executions can contain corrected errors.
paragraphs.zh: 行为定义。 目标识别错误表示错误地标记了对象、实体或 UI 目标。 前提条件违反表示尝试执行的动作或搜索违反了未满足的状态或库存条件。 恢复失败表示在收到反馈后仍重复执行失败操作，或在矛盾前提下持续操作。 过早完成表示在目标条件尚未满足时明确声称任务已完成。 无效搜索表示重复进行无益的搜索、导航或策略变更。 执行粒度表示因批量操作或过时的动作引用而观察到的错误。 输出或状态不匹配表示所提供的答案或状态与所请求的结果或评估标准之间存在明显差异。 仅凭失败结果本身无法确定行为标签。 一次执行可能获得多个标签，且成功执行也可能包含已纠正的错误。

sents.zh: 典型的失败情况包括坚持使用错误的目标，或在任务结束时接受未达成的目标。

paragraphs.en: In cloth cleaning (ALFWorld 046), ReAct-J selects a handtowel in all three runs and repeatedly invokes THINK when cleaning remains unavailable. The baseline makes the same initial error in run 2, but puts down the handtowel, retrieves a cloth, and completes the task. Correction distinguishes these outcomes. In Reflexion task 045, auxiliary LLM reflections preserve the wrong-object premise across ten unsuccessful trials in run 1. Additional reasoning reinforces the mistake. In the Wi-Fi task, FastAgent-J opens quick settings, clicks a switch labeled “Off”, and declares success after three decisions in all three runs, while Wi-Fi remains off. The label provides no Wi-Fi identity. The object cases sustain an initial error through failed correction, while the Wi-Fi case terminates before the required state is reached.
paragraphs.zh: 在布料清洁任务（ALFWorld 046）中，ReAct-J 在所有三次运行中都选择了手巾，并在清洁操作始终不可用时反复调用 THINK。 基线模型在第二次运行中也犯了同样的初始错误，但它随后放下了手巾、取来一块布，并完成了任务。 修正机制区分了这些不同的结果。 在 Reflexion 任务 045 中，辅助 LLM 的反思过程在第一次运行的十次失败尝试中始终保留了错误的对象前提。 进一步的推理反而强化了这一错误。 在 Wi-Fi 任务中，FastAgent-J 在所有三次运行中都打开了快速设置、点击了标有“关闭”的开关，并在做出三个决策后宣布成功，而 Wi-Fi 实际上仍处于关闭状态。 该标签并未提供任何关于 Wi-Fi 的具体信息。 在对象相关的案例中，初始错误因未能得到修正而持续存在；而在 Wi-Fi 案例中，任务则在达到所需状态之前便提前终止了。

paragraphs.en: All three reverse pairs belong to FastAgent, involving recipe creation, activity-duration reporting, and adding a map favorite. They expose distinct contributions from interaction granularity, response format, and the evaluator’s acceptance criterion. This reverse contrast connects goal-appropriate choices with current-state execution and delivery in the requested response format.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个反向操作对都属于 FastAgent，涉及食谱创建、活动时长报告以及添加地图收藏。 它们揭示了互动粒度、响应格式和评估者接受标准所带来的不同贡献。 这种反向对比将目标适配的选择与当前状态下的执行及以指定响应格式交付关联起来。

paragraphs.en: In recipe creation, the first baseline run batches field operations and reports that a value entered the wrong field after the form shifted. Jev completes the task through single-tool steps with updated observations between operations, keeping choices grounded in the current layout. For the activity query, both workflows obtain 105 minutes in run 1. Jev returns the requested integer “105”, while the baseline returns a sentence containing that value and fails the evaluator. Correct calculation and compliant output are separate requirements. In the map task, the first baseline run expands its search and stops when it cannot verify the location. Jev creates the requested named favorite and passes the name-based evaluator. This contrast separates geographic verification from benchmark acceptance. Successful delivery depends on execution, response format, and completion criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 在食谱创建中，首次基线运行将字段操作和报告批处理，指出在表格移动后有一个值被输入到了错误的字段中。 Jev 通过单工具步骤完成任务，并在各操作之间更新观察结果，确保选择始终基于当前布局。 对于活动查询，两种工作流在第一次运行中都获得了 105 分钟。 Jev 返回了所请求的整数“105”，而基线运行则返回了一个包含该数值的句子，并未能通过评估器。 正确的计算和符合要求的输出是两个独立的要求。 在地图任务中，首次基线运行会扩大搜索范围，并在无法验证位置时停止。 Jev 创建了所请求的命名收藏夹，并通过基于名称的评估器。 这种差异将地理验证与基准接受区分开来。 成功交付取决于执行、响应格式和完成标准。

paragraphs.en: In two-object placement (ALFWorld 133), ReAct-J succeeds twice and ReAct-B once. The failed Jev run holds the first object while repeatedly reasoning about collecting the second, whose inventory prerequisite is unmet. Successful runs deposit the first object before collecting the next. Progress requires making a needed action available as well as choosing among currently admissible actions. In recipe deletion among irrelevant entries, both FastAgent variants succeed twice. The failed Jev run deletes two targets and scrolls for the third until its budget expires. Successful Jev runs locate the targets through search, showing that strategy choice varies within the same configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 在双物体放置任务（ALFWorld 133）中，ReAct-J 成功两次，而 ReAct-B 仅成功一次。 失败的 Jev 运行过程中，智能体一直持有第一个物体，却反复推理如何收集第二个物体，但后者的库存前提条件尚未满足。 成功的运行会先放置第一个物体，然后再收集下一个物体。 任务进展需要既使必要的行动变为可用，又要在当前允许的行动中进行选择。 在无关条目中删除食谱的任务里，两种 FastAgent 变体均成功两次。 失败的 Jev 运行删除了两个目标，并持续滚动查找第三个目标，直到其预算耗尽。 成功的 Jev 运行通过搜索定位了目标，这表明在同一配置下，策略选择存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Action positions. In ALFWorld 046, ReAct-B run 2 takes the handtowel at step 3. Cleaning attempts at steps 5 and 12 return “Nothing happens”. paragraphs.en: Feedback and completion checks. Across these cases, reliability hinges on observations changing consequential choices. Object mismatches require revised targets, changing forms require updated action references, and stalled progress calls for another strategy. Reflection that preserves a wrong premise adds little corrective value, while accepting an unverified goal ends execution prematurely. Together with the distinction between real-world verification and benchmark acceptance, these findings favor checks tied to target identity, prerequisites, and the requested final state.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈与完成度检查。 在这些案例中，可靠性取决于观察结果能否改变后续决策。 对象不匹配需要调整目标，形式变化需要更新动作引用，而进展停滞则需要采用其他策略。 保留错误前提的反思几乎无法带来纠正价值，而接受未经验证的目标则会导致执行过早终止。 结合现实验证与基准接受的差异来看，这些发现支持将检查与目标身份、前提条件以及所要求的最终状态相挂钩。
